key_idea: Compare the straight parts of each path.
steps: Each path is made of straight parts. Some parts are short and some are long.
D has 5 parts: 3 long parts going across and 2 short parts going down.
E has 4 parts: 2 long parts and 2 short parts. So D is longer than E by one long part.
A, B and C have shorter parts and no more than 4 of them, so they are shorter than D.

choice_feedback.A: A has only 3 parts, and none of them is as long as a long part of D.
choice_feedback.B: B has 4 short parts. That is shorter than D.
choice_feedback.C: C has 1 middle-sized part and 3 short parts. That is shorter than D.
choice_feedback.E: E has 2 long and 2 short parts, but D has 3 long and 2 short parts.
